name: Ghostdesk
description: Reads company reports, picks S&P 500 stocks and trades them each month with paper money, with no person at the desk. Each stock-picking model was tested once, under a plan registered before the test data was used.

name: Pitchvision
description: Fills in the football players that a TV broadcast does not show, with a calibrated region for each one. The model runs in the browser on real Bundesliga clips.

name: Pitwall
description: Builds a race-strategy model one layer at a time from public lap data, and tests each layer on races it has not seen. The undercut tool runs in the browser.
